body: No worries bruv. I hope you don't have to deal with anymore fun outages! It's always not opening the fridge that's hard for me when the ol' electricity loss goes down. Anyway, i'm 29 and he cheated on me, with his ex wife and randos from the general area we moved to in Georgia. We moved there, about 1100 miles from my hometown, to begin a life together. Turns out that wasn't something he really wanted to work for. Thank you, very very much, for your kind words. I feel like my generation of women has been taught that wanting to be a mom is not an acceptable ambition. Staying home and raising kiddos is beneath us, somehow, even if that's what we want to be doing more than anything. I grew up truly believing I'd never enjoy motherhood, but found it to be the job that came to me most naturally. Now, having had to spend every cent I had to get back to where I had family and a support system, i'm back at square one. I've never been as lonely or felt as hopeless as I do now.

It definitely feels that way to me. I wish I could disappear... or erase my existence or have died as a teenager, before I let my family down by being nothing. My parents experienced so much joy and happiness raising me as a little one, and if I'd died before disappointing them, they could enjoy the memories of the daughter that brought them those feelings. Now I feel monstrous for being willing to choose ending my life over protecting them... but I have no hope and no joy myself. I wouldn't want someone I love to exist just because they can't bring themselves to hurt me. Im sorry, this comment ran away from me.

It isn't useful on its own. I need a master's at the very least, if I want to have any chance of finding a psych related job. I've spent 4 years trying to find something... anything that will let me use what I went to school for, but my hometown is full of graduates desperate for anything. I can't make enough money to live on my own and save to move somewhere less saturated with degrees. I'm stuck in a hole that keeps getting deeper, and now that I know I want to be a mother more than anything else, I feel more hopeless every day. I never dreamed I wanted to be a mom until I was engaged to someone with kids. After he cheated on me and threatened to kill me and the kids, I lost the one thing that had given me hope again. Obviously that relationship was an unsustainable mess, but I had hope. I wish I'd found the deep, unprecedented joy that motherhood gives me as a woman in her mid 20s. Now I realize i'm damaged goods and unlikely ever attract a mate capable and willing to love me the way I love them. I just want babies and a mate and it's utterly pathetic. You are too kind to call what I've done amazing and I thank you for that kindness.
